sub_items.description: Pentagon press briefing clip – Cam Higby asks Pentagon press secretary about a "French military plot to assassinate Candace Owens"
Blake Neff tweet announcing December 15, 2025 TPUSA livestream debate with 24-hour countdown
Blake Neff follow-up tweet stating TPUSA will "proceed without" Candace
Project Constitution X post asserting Egyptian presidency website confirms President El-Sisi flew on aircraft SU-BTU on April 3, 2023
Ben Shapiro audio/video clip from Greg Gutfeld's show – French intelligence joke regarding Greg
Frank Turk audio/video clip asserting Charlie Kirk told him Blake Neff was "the smartest man I know" / "secret weapon"
Tim Pool video clip calling Candace Owens a "scumbag" and warning of midterm losses due to her commentary
Photograph of President El-Sisi meeting Tunisian Prime Minister Sara Zaafarani in Egypt on September 10, 2025
Egyptian Presidency website record confirming El-Sisi aboard SU-BTU on April 3, 2023 (Riadh → Saudi Crown Prince MBS meeting)

nodes.name: Cam Higby
nodes.description: Pentagon correspondent whose question to the Pentagon press secretary regarding a "French military plot to assassinate Candace Owens" is presented in the episode. Host asserts he has been on TPUSA payroll since August 2025.

nodes.name: Wed Mahmoud
nodes.description: Person using this name on board the "yellow plane" SU-BND on September 10, 2025 (one of four passengers). Host asserts same individual flew on SU-BTU ("purple plane") into Provo on May 27, 2025. Identity verification target.

nodes.name: Sara Zaafarani
nodes.description: Tunisian Prime Minister. Photographed with President El-Sisi in Egypt on September 10, 2025, per host assertion; used as alibi for El-Sisi.

nodes.name: Frank Turek
nodes.description: TPUSA affiliate whose testimonial clip is played, asserting that Charlie Kirk told him Blake Neff was "the smartest man I know."

nodes.name: Wedi Machmood Identity Verification Question
nodes.description: Persistent unresolved target: who is the person using the name "Wedi Machmood" – possibly a pilot, possibly a person well acquainted with President El-Sisi given use of a presidential Egyptian military aircraft.

nodes.name: SU-BTU May 27 – June 2, 2025 Provo Visit with Wedi Machmood Aboard
nodes.description: Egyptian military aircraft SU-BTU allegedly flew into Provo on May 27, 2025 with Wedi Machmood aboard, and departed June 2, 2025 without transponder data. Distinct from the September 10 yellow plane (SU-BND) incident.

nodes.name: Charlie Kirk
nodes.description: Primary investigative subject of the series; relevant in this episode as the victim whose case is being reopened.

nodes.name: Project Constitution
nodes.description: X account whose tweet (read in full on air) is cited as the source for the Egyptian-presidency confirmation that El-Sisi flew SU-BTU on April 3, 2023.

nodes.name: Candace Owens
nodes.description: Host; target of paid clipping and DoD-adjacent smear; satirizes Candyland nanny comments; organizes tip intake.

nodes.name: Ben Shapiro
nodes.description: Atlantic: Servius manages Shapiro clipping campaign listed at $30k prior month on Monster Lab.

nodes.name: Blake Neff
nodes.description: Commenter analogy "Blake Nef thing" for high-place gaslighting; host agrees pattern.

nodes.name: Tim Pool
nodes.description: Made two contradictory statements about Candace's security within one week.

claims.label: Higby Pentagon Question on French Assassination Plot
claims.claim: Pentagon correspondent Cam Higby asked the Pentagon press secretary whether the Department of Defense had any evidence of a "French military plot to assassinate Candace Owens."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original Pentagon press briefing transcript and date; confirm Higby's professional affiliations at the time.

claims.label: TPUSA Midnight Debate Announcement
claims.claim: TPUSA's Blake Neff issued a tweet near midnight on December 4, 2025 announcing a formal response livestream scheduled for December 15, 2025 at 2:00 PM Eastern / 2:00 PM local in Phoenix, with a 24-hour countdown for Candace to confirm in-person attendance.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm original tweet via X/Twitter archive; verify timestamp and wording.

claims.label: TPUSA "Proceeding Without You" Follow-Up Tweet
claims.claim: After Candace Owens publicly offered to participate virtually, TPUSA's Blake Neff tweeted that TPUSA would proceed with the December 15 livestream without her.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm original follow-up tweet via X/Twitter archive; compare with Candace's tweet offering virtual attendance.

claims.label: Project Constitution Report on El-Sisi Aboard SU-BTU
claims.claim: A Project Constitution X post (read in full on air) reports that the Egyptian presidency website confirms President El-Sisi flew aboard aircraft SU-BTU on April 3, 2023 to Riyadh for a meeting with Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify directly against the Egyptian presidency website; reconcile Project Constitution's reference to "SU-BTU" with host's reference to "BTT" / "SUB-TU."

claims.label: El-Sisi Photographed in Egypt on September 10, 2025
claims.claim: President El-Sisi was photographed at a meeting with Tunisian Prime Minister Sara Zaafarani in Egypt on September 10, 2025, which the host cites as ruling out El-Sisi as the mystery passenger on the yellow plane that day.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original photograph; verify date, location, and participants.

claims.label: Shapiro Joke on Gutfeld Show
claims.claim: Ben Shapiro appeared on Greg Gutfeld's show and joked that he "called French intelligence and something may or may not have happened to Greg [Gutfeld]."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify clip against original Gutfeld show broadcast; confirm exact wording.

claims.label: Frank Turk Testimonial on Blake Neff
claims.claim: Frank Turk states in a video testimonial that the night before Charlie Kirk's death, Kirk told him that Blake Neff was Kirk's "secret weapon" and "the smartest man I know."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify clip against original broadcast; cross-check against other contemporaneous accounts.

claims.label: Tim Pool Attack on Candace Owens
claims.claim: Tim Pool states in a video that Candace Owens is a "scumbag" who is dividing conservatives and risks losing the midterms and 2028 by continuing to question the official Kirk narrative.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify clip against original Tim Pool broadcast; capture full context.
